seed: A see-through drawing opens the shade macOS and a browser draw it: a 30 percent square, a faded group of two overlapping squares (the lower one does not show where they meet), a 40 percent line around a solid fill, and colours written with their own see-through amount. No switches: this is Next as it comes.

steps.note: black at 30 percent over the white canvas: 178 grey, as macOS and a browser draw the file
a group at 30 percent: where the blue square covers the black one it is plain pale blue, the black does not show through
a 40 percent black line around a solid green circle: grey outside, dark green over the fill, never solid black
rgba red at 50 percent is pink, not solid red; the purple at 45 percent covers it lower down
